decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory that complements the core trailer business and service network, it is inexpensive to keep as an option while still adding customer value.
A box car trailer series fits the firm's core capabilities and growth strategy, so the option value of staying in this mainstream segment outweighs the cost of continuation.

A car transporter trailer line is more specialized and costly to support, and by 2022 management would likely view the remaining uncertainty as low enough to exit if traction has not clearly justified further commitment.
The low-bed trailer series is close to the firm's existing know-how and was prominently marketed, making it worth retaining as a credible growth option in the core range.
High trailer covers are modular add-ons with strong overlap with existing products, so they are cheap to maintain and support the broader trailer portfolio.
Even with some overlap risk, a box car trailer series remains strategically central for a German mid-sized trailer maker, so management would more likely keep than abandon it.
